text:
ashok: Heads up — Billing alert showed a ~28% drop in GPU RI utilization for eu-west-1 this AM. Renewals coming up next month. Can we triage quickly?

maria: hmm that's big. Is it a specific instance family (p4 vs a10) or across the board? Any signal from the autoscaling groups?

liam: I pulled a quick query from our cost lake: `SELECT region, instance_family, usage_hours FROM reservation_usage WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND date >= '2026-02-01'` — biggest drop is `p4d` pool, usage hours down 31% last 7d vs prior 7d.

samir: +1. Also seeing a cluster placement change: last week we shifted some training jobs to dedicated-dgx-2 pools in eu-central to avoid noisy neighbors. Might be the cause.

ashok: good catch. So likely migration caused orphaned RIs in eu-west-1. Do we have tag drift? are the VMs still tagged to the old project so billing attribution moved?

katie: I checked tag consistency. ~12% of GPU instances in eu-west-1 lost the `team:training` tag after the orchestration rollout on 2026-02-25. That can break our RI matching rules.

cost-bot: :rotating_light: Cost Alert generated: ReservedInstanceUtilization decreased 28% (24h). Details: https://console.costs.internal/company/redwood/alerts/RI-2123456789

maria: If tag drift is part of it, we can quickly re-tag short-lived VMs via the agent. But longer-term we need to avoid relying solely on tags for RI matching — our reservation footprint is region+family-based.

liam: Actionable steps I propose: 1) Re-tag affected instances (scripts ready). 2) Backfill short workloads to eu-west-1 if feasible. 3) Evaluate exchanging P4 RIs for more flexible Savings Plans or different family if usage pattern changed.

samir: For exchange, AWS has limited convertible RI options; but we could run a what-if: `aws ce get-reservation-purchase-recommendation --service "AmazonEC2" --lookback-period "SEVEN_DAYS"` and compare Savings Plan recommendation. I can run it and share results.

katie: Also flagging amortization windows: if we change renewals now we might lose committed discount for the remainder of term. Need finance input on write-offs vs expected savings.

ashok: OK. Short timeline: triage and quick fixes today, decisions for renewals by EOD Friday. Who will own each?

maria: I'll own re-tagging + short-term placement changes.

liam: I'll run the reservation vs savings-plan recommendations and surface the delta (cost / flexibility / downtime risk).

samir: I'll produce a per-instance-family utilization heatmap for eu-west-1 (last 90d) so we can spot permanent vs transient declines.

katie: I'll coordinate with finance and model the P&L impact if we postpone a portion of the renewal vs convert to SPs.

ashok: Great. Temporary mitigation: set a policy to avoid swapping critical training jobs out of eu-west-1 until we stabilize RIs. I'll add a canary flag to rollout process.

maria: Quick note — I'll run the re-tag script with `--dry-run` first, post output here, then run live after signoff.

liam: ETA for my run is 3h. samir your heatmap ETA?

samir: 2h. I'll attach CSV link when ready.

katie: Finance will need the utilization heatmap + liam's cost delta to sign off on any renewal changes.

ashok: Cool. If we can get those by EOD we can make an informed call. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
